site_name: Land west of the A49 Mill Lane and to the East of the West Coast Mainline railway line, Newton-le-Willows
evidence_slice: The National Data Library entry published by St Helens Council describes its Local Plan Allocated Housing Site dataset as polygon data for allocated housing sites and states that table fields include site reference and site name. St Helens Council's Site 7HA delivery note identifies Land west of the A49 Mill Lane and to the East of the West Coast Mainline railway line, Newton-le-Willows as proposed residential allocation 7HA and records a revised indicative capacity of 140 dwellings after part of the site was committed to the relocated Penkford School. The Local Plan Inspectors' Report records that the Plan allocates land west of the A49, Newton (7HA), and confirms the revised yield of about 140 dwellings.
